hack.category: Financial NFT / Token Vesting / Liquidity Lock
hack.root_cause: ERC1155 reentrancy via onERC1155Received — fnftId update timing flaw inflates FNFT redemption value
hack.description: Revest Finance lost $2M when an attacker used an ERC1155 mint callback to re-enter the vault mid-transaction, exploiting a timing flaw in FNFT ID tracking to assign real token value to 360,000 worthless receipt tokens.
